title: FRAMES: Failure Recovery And Monitoring of Embodied Skills for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.22538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) planners can decompose natural-language instructions and select reusable robot skills, but choosing the correct skill does not guarantee successful physical execution. This gap is especially important in humanoid loco-manipulation, where errors during approach, grasping, transport, or placement can invalidate the remainder of a long-horizon plan. We present FRAMES, a failure-aware supervisory framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid that operates above the CEER whole-body controller. A Planner Agent selects subtasks through parameterized mid-level skills, while a vision-language-model-based Monitor Agent evaluates each skill using temporal multi-view observations and structured robot and contact evidence. Detected failures stop the active skill and provide grounded feedback to a Recovery Agent. translated_title: FRAMES：面向人形机器人移动操作的具身技能故障恢复与监控
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）规划器能够分解自然语言指令并选择可复用的机器人技能，但选择正确的技能并不能保证物理执行的成功。这一差距在人形机器人移动操作中尤为重要，因为在接近、抓取、搬运或放置过程中的错误可能会使长时程计划的其余部分失效。我们提出了FRAMES，这是一个面向宇树Unitree G1人形机器人的故障感知监督框架，运行在CEER全身控制器之上。规划智能体通过参数化的中层技能选择子任务，而基于视觉语言模型的监控智能体利用时序多视角观测以及结构化的机器人状态和接触证据来评估每项技能的执行情况。检测到的故障会停止当前正在执行的技能，并向恢复智能体提供有依据的反馈。该框架还包括一个用于复用先前技能经验的记忆模块，以及通过深度信息实现的几何定位。
tldr: 提出了FRAMES故障感知监督框架，利用基于视觉语言模型的监控智能体结合多视角观测与机器人接触证据实时检测人形机器人移动操作中的技能执行故障，并通过恢复智能体和记忆模块实现故障恢复与经验复用。
en_tdlr: FRAMES is a failure-aware supervisory framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that uses a vision-language-model-based monitor agent with temporal multi-view observations and contact evidence to detect skill execution failures, enabling grounded recovery and experience reuse through a recovery agent and memory module.
